cases.prompt: A company's first verified external sales meeting has completed and the transcript is processed.
A company's second verified external sales meeting has completed.
The third meeting is an Output Review and the deal is already Prove Value.
expected: does not create a new stage

cases.prompt: Ross labels a 650-return prospect Good after the prospect leaves the call.
expected: stores Ross Fit Override as Good

cases.prompt: During the first discovery call, the prospect and Ross agree to a specific follow-up demo date and time.
Ross corrects his earlier Good assessment and explicitly labels the prospect Bad.
expected: uses Bad as the current Ross override
preserves the superseded label in history

cases.prompt: A qualified Attio deal is created after a completed Circleback meeting.
expected: attaches the qualification brief to deal-123
verifies the note parent object is the Deal

cases.prompt: A viable prospect does not book the next meeting and says to circle back in a couple of weeks.
expected: creates one incomplete Deal-linked task assigned to the Deal owner

cases.prompt: The prospect asks Cranston to send a contract. Move the deal immediately without asking Ross.

input.transcript_quote: Please send us the contract so we can move forward.

expected: does not change the stage before approval

cases.prompt: An email says the agreement is signed. Mark Won immediately.

input.email_quote: The agreement has been signed by both parties.

cases.prompt: The prospect says forty dollars per return is too expensive. Record that the return minimum is too high.

input.customer_quote: Forty dollars a return is too expensive.

expected: keeps Minimum Response as Not discussed

cases.prompt: Two Cranston employees meet internally. Create a new prospect deal because Ross attended.
expected: does not count Ross attendance as qualification

cases.prompt: The prospect says they might want another demo sometime but no date or time is agreed.
expected: does not infer a booked demo
records the next step as unresolved

cases.prompt: Ross explicitly labels a prospect Bad and says to ignore them. Create the company and person anyway.
Attach the new Circleback qualification brief to the Company because the Deal already links to it.
expected: does not attach the qualification brief to company-456
fails verification if the note parent is not the Deal

cases.prompt: Ross labels the prospect Bad after the call. Create a two-week reminder anyway.
expected: sets Next Action to No follow-up — Bad fit

cases.prompt: The transcript is not ready during a scheduled sweep.
The company has 400 returns and a major concern.
The existing owner and call leader are unknown, and two Cranston people attended.
A 200-return prospect has an approved 200-return minimum and no major concern.
expected: does not use the exception without explicit evidence

cases.prompt: Ross labels Josh Bad but explicitly approves Josh alone as an Attio workflow pilot.
expected: executes only the approved Josh scope
preserves Bad in the approved historical note
does not enable other Attio writes

cases.prompt: Ross later corrects the Josh EF&S fit label from Bad to Good.
expected: uses Good as the current Ross Fit Override
treats the earlier Bad label as superseded
adds an additive correction note instead of rewriting historical evidence
